about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Russ Fulcher

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FOREIGN EMISSIONS AND NONATTAINMENT CLARIFICATION FOR ECONOMIC STABILITY ACT
statements.title: FOREIGN EMISSIONS AND NONATTAINMENT CLARIFICATION FOR ECONOMIC STABILITY ACT
sentences: You may not think of my home State of Idaho as a border State when you start thinking about border States, but Idaho is a border State.
We share an international border with Canada in the northern panhandle of the State of Idaho.
Oftentimes, that smoke, those pollutants, blow right over the border, and there is absolutely nothing that the State of Idaho can do with that.
It is true that the Clean Air Act has a provision to address that.
The EPA guidance, largely enforced with the previous administration, conflicts with the Clean Air Act provision allowing States to adjust their emission plans.
Every time one of those fires breaks out, we become at risk of falling out of our emissions standards.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 6409, the FENCES Act.
Mr. Speaker, I stand in strong support of H.R. 6409, and I urge my colleagues to do the same.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REDUCING AND ELIMINATING DUPLICATIVE ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATIONS ACT
statements.title: REDUCING AND ELIMINATING DUPLICATIVE ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATIONS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 6398, the RED Tape Act.
Again, I rise in support of H.R. 6398, and I encourage my colleagues to do the same.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SHARIA-FREE AMERICA
statements.title: SHARIA-FREE AMERICA
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I am proud to stand beside my colleagues here today.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SECURE RURAL SCHOOLS REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SECURE RURAL SCHOOLS REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: Rural counties in Idaho are impacted even more so by extensive federal ownership, as they are unable to tax large portions of land in their jurisdiction.
However, a long-term solution is necessary, and I will continue to advocate for one in Congress that ensures Idahoans dictate Idaho affairs--not the federal government.

statements.title: WORLD WAR II WOMEN'S MEMORIAL LOCATION ACT

statements.title: INFORMING CONSUMERS ABOUT SMART DEVICES ACT

I urge support for this legislation.
